+### 2026-10-20 — F14 textured-input and native-composition production measurements
+
+Owner: implementation engineer; estimate: measured follow-up within the unchanged complete roadmap. The preceding turn adopted and verified the textured crop/readback correction. This continuation completes its previously pending clean studies without changing application source during either measurement.
+
+Six alternating normal-production runs cover twelve textured tool/target/size fixtures and retain 1,440 newly matching trusted movements, 72 native long-task controls, 216 complete PNGs and 216 independently decoded checksummed projects. Every gesture retains all 21 exact x/y/pressure points, one intended operation, original texture bytes and exact model/pixel undo. Candidate median per-run p95 ranges14.0–36.8ms. Maximum-size pencil-mask p95 improves95.7→31.6ms, the1800-pixel variant89.0→31.9ms and the900-pixel variant55.1→32.4ms. Small pencil-mask latency increases7.9→14.7ms;900-pixel filter-mask erasing increases22.8→28.3ms. The2048/1800-pixel filter-mask medians34.5/36.8ms still fail33ms, and individual candidate runs also exceed33ms in the900-pixel pencil fixture. No overlapping gesture long task is reported. This is mixed progress, not editor-wide responsiveness acceptance or a universal speedup.
+
+Six fixture appearances remain byte-exact to the former renderer. Three hard-brush edges change by up to37/43/42 alpha bytes and three filter-mask appearances change RGB by up to10/12/11 bytes with alpha unchanged. Independent32768-subrow circle-intersection integration matches every candidate alpha pixel at all three sizes in every run; the previous renderer differs at130–135 edge pixels. These are three synthetic opaque-texture geometries, not representative-photo, partial-texture or device quality acceptance.
+
+A separate six-run alternating full-native50MP low-retouch export study compares corrected texture renderers differing only in256/512 composition cores. All six10000×5000 RGBA images decode identically, contain real edits relative to the source, and preserve source/model hashes. Median export falls37313.6→32177.7ms (13.8% locally); Gaussian calls3160→3081 and sampled pixels71064000→70432320. All six native long-task controls are observed; no overlapping export long task is reported. Headless animation-gap p95 remains about19.9–20.3ms and is a scheduling proxy, not physical display evidence. No competing builds/tests ran. Roughly32-second export is still slow.
+
+[Sealed paired performance evidence](benchmarks/texture-frequency-production-performance-2026-10-20.json) preserves complete reports, independent project/PNG/geometry checks, measured source/WASM/release identities and original outputs; all37 previous artifacts remain byte-identical. Next work investigates remaining sampling/task overhead and large filter-mask latency while preserving exact pixels and full scope. Sustained/editor-wide/release latency, extreme native bitmap projection, portrait quality, physical/tablet/hardware-GPU/display/process memory and every other unfinished professional, AI/provider, workflow and commercial requirement remain active. +## Textured input and native composition — 2026-10-20
+
+The [sealed alternating studies](benchmarks/texture-frequency-production-performance-2026-10-20.json) compare twelve synthetic opaque-texture fixtures through normal production UI, with twenty paced trusted movements per gesture and three runs per variant. Native matching-canvas-copy timestamps precede the one-pixel validation read; every sample must newly match known exact RGBA. Saved original/edited/undo projects independently preserve source blobs, all21 points and exactly one authored operation. Complete PNG/model undo and native75ms long-task controls are verified. The reference is the pre-texture-correction release; changed legacy edge appearance is recorded separately from speed.

An independent32768-subrow circle-area integral matches every current alpha pixel in all three circle fixtures, but does not establish broader image quality. These results do not establish sustained/editor-wide, physical/tablet/display or whole-process-memory acceptance.

Native long-task controls are positive and no overlapping export long task is reported. Animation-gap p95 is19.9–20.3ms, a headless scheduling proxy. No competing builds/tests ran. A roughly32-second export and the remaining input misses still require work; no general60fps or complete F14 claim is made.
